summary: The boundary receipt closed the last open question in the direction the source ordering predicted, and it closes the run's investigation cleanly. With the tightest uniform configuration ValidateConfig accepts — heartbeat 50ms, election timeout 51ms, lease 50ms — the declared control held and was complete over all sixteen trials: no trial saw a competing leader appear while the cut-off leader was still confirming, the confirmations ran eighteen to twenty-one per trial and ended between 47ms and 56ms, and the leader stepped down every time. So a one-millisecond margin above the lease still separates, which puts the uniform-case bound on the direction of the inequality rather than on any slack in the timers. Read with the mixed-timer work, both sides of that boundary are now measured: a voter whose election timer sits below the leader's lease produces the overlap in twenty of twenty trials, and one whose timer sits above it produces none even at a one-millisecond margin. I recorded the interpretation, cited the corrected behaviour entry at its revision, noted that the 2ms poll bounds the precision of a one-millisecond claim, and marked the question answered. That leaves the run's record complete and self-consistent: three execution-grounded findings — the startup replay that blocks NewRaft once the committed-but-unapplied window exceeds the FSM channel's batch capacity, the nonvoter acknowledgement that satisfies VerifyLeader's voter quorum and, under per-node timers, can accompany committed state the confirming leader never applied, and the membership change that installs a voter immediately and can strand a single-voter cluster — together with four refuted suspicions and one excluded cause, each carrying the evidence that settled it, one behaviour entry corrected under its own id with the affected use answered, every registered question answered, and no necessary gap outstanding. Nothing in the run required weakening a requirement or suppressing contrary evidence: the two findings that started as suspicions were narrowed or refuted by their own receipts, and the three that survived are stated with the conditions and limits their witnesses actually support.
